title: Razkadr Storyboard
description: Central object of Razkadr: video sources, episodes with frames and texts. See docs/storyboard.md.

schema_version.description: Storyboard schema version, semver (patch may be omitted: 1.0 == 1.0.0). Schema file storyboard.v1.json validates major version 1 only.

title.description: Human-readable document title, shown on the title slide.

preset.description: Scenario preset that defines episode roles and scoring profile (MVP: recipe).

path.description: Local path of the normalized video file.

url.description: Original URL the video was ingested from, if any.

duration_s.description: Duration in seconds; episode times are checked against it when present.

id.description: Episode identifier, unique within the storyboard.

role.description: Role in the document structure, defined by the preset (e.g. hero, ingredients, step).

source_id.description: Reference to an entry in sources.

t_start.description: Episode start time in seconds from the beginning of the source.

t_end.description: Episode end time in seconds; must be >= t_start.

path.description: Path of the representative frame image.

score.description: Combined frame score from the selection stage.

score_parts.description: Named score components; keys are preset-defined, values are normalized to [0, 1].

alternatives.description: Runner-up frames for this episode, best first.

text.description: Episode text. Absent in a draft storyboard produced by the selection stage.

mode.description: verbatim: transcript as spoken; condensed: shortened; described: VLM description of the frame (silent video).

original.description: Text derived from the source transcript.

output.description: Text rendered on the slide (possibly translated).

user_edited.description: True once the user changed the episode (frame, text, order); regeneration must preserve it.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag. MVP uses primary subtags ru and en; full IANA registry validation is out of scope.
